prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: diffuse colour texture for a traditional Japanese Shogi board surface, used identically in 2D and on a physical 3D kaya-style board.
Primary request: A perfectly straight-down macro photograph of one uninterrupted, carefully planed Japanese kaya-style pale golden wood surface. Fine close vertical quarter-sawn grain runs from the bottom to the top of the square. Quiet, sophisticated, natural wood with creamy straw and light honey tones, subtly undulating parallel growth lines and almost invisible pores. The grain is much finer and calmer than oak or pine. No knots, no seams, no planks, no circles, no dark streaks.
Composition: Entire square filled edge to edge with a single continuous clean wood surface, orthographic top-down, no perspective, no object edges, no surrounding scene. The visible area represents about 45cm by45cm. This is a board material colour map: no painted grid, no lettering, no symbols, no game pieces, no frames or ornament.
Lighting: Flat neutral diffuse illumination, even exposure across the whole image, no cast shadows, no specular highlight, no vignette, no baked reflections. Satin planed timber texture, understated fine detail. Keep mean colour pale warm straw, roughly sRGB #e1bf82 with gentle natural variation, not saturated orange, not yellow plastic. Sharp enough for a luxurious close look, restrained enough to leave dark Shogi markings and honey-boxwood pieces clearly readable.
Output: one opaque square photographic material image at high resolution, no transparency, no labels, no watermark.
